title: Accessory images manifest
description: Vendor-hosted images for accessory parts. Every vendor + SKU in data/accessories/*.json appears exactly once, in images or in missing. scripts/lib.mjs validateAccessoryImages() enforces the rules this schema cannot express (catalog membership, file existence and size, vendor domains).

retrieved.description: Date the manifest was last updated.

sourcing_rule.description: The rule every image follows, for example "Vendor-hosted sources only".

vendor.description: Must match the vendor of an accessories catalog exactly.

sku.description: Must exist in that vendor's catalog.

file.description: Path under src/assets/, served from the site root.

source_page_url.description: Vendor page or document the image comes from.

caption_note.description: What the image shows when it is shared or not tied to this exact SKU.

reason.description: What was checked and why no vendor image was used.
